summary.name: ReadSpeaker
summary.one_liner: ReadSpeaker is a text-to-speech company offering cloud, on-premise, and embedded voice engines, plus custom brand voices, for education, enterprise, and accessibility use.
use_cases: Adding read-aloud support to an LMS, Moodle or Brightspace course
Making PDFs and course material listenable for students
Creating a custom branded voice for products or call centres
Running on-premise speech for defense or secure networks
Adding voice to SCORM e-learning packages
Producing audio editions of published titles
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ReadSpeaker as a text-to-speech vendor with more than 27 years in voice technology, serving education and enterprise customers in 90+ languages. Its product lineup includes a cloud API, on-premise and embedded speech engines, an IVR/contact-centre MRCP server, a Microsoft SAPI voice bridge, and browser and desktop tools (speechMaker Studio and Desktop) for producing audio. For education it lists LMS integrations (Moodle certified, plus Blackboard, Brightspace, Schoology), accessible assessments, and voice added to SCORM packages from tools such as Genially, Rise, Adobe Captivate, Lectora and iSpring. It also offers Custom Voice, where a voice is designed and trained for a brand, and a free demo where visitors can type text and hear a voice.
notable: Deployment choice: fully hosted cloud, on-premise inside your own network, or fully offline embedded engine
Custom brand voices built with a voice actor and VoiceLab linguistic team
Moodle certified LMS integration and SCORM voice add-on for existing courses
Microsoft SAPI and MRCP standards support for Windows software and contact-centre systems
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; enterprise and custom work requires contacting the vendor
Custom voice creation is a project-based service rather than an instant self-serve tool
Platform list for desktop and mobile is not fully specified; Windows, Linux, Docker, iOS, Android are inferred from product names only and not clearly stated
